role: ours development candidate; formal baseline implementations and scores are read-only and untouched

scope.answers: Original RAGTruth QA development fit634 + calibration159 only.
scope.claims: The 9,055 fit and 2,267 calibration lexical microclaims frozen by atomic_microclaim_nli_v1.
scope.windows: Unchanged eligible four raw-BPE, stride-one windows; punctuation remains in width.
scope.official_test: No official-test path or loader exists in this runner.

upstream_gate.required: atomic_microclaim_nli_v1 complete.json plus evidence_features.npy, feature_names.json, microclaim_labels.npy and summary.json
upstream_gate.missing_behavior: Write readiness.json with status WAIT_UPSTREAM, print WAIT, fit nothing, and emit no metric.

views.relation: The upstream frozen raw 315-dimensional evidence/relation feature row for the same microclaim.
views.harp: First 205 coordinates of the existing ascending bottom-256 output-head basis; per claim concatenate mean and signed maximum-absolute-value pooling (410 dims).

trace.nll: mean, max, min, std, and fraction above the current outer-training-fold 90th percentile
trace.ghost: mean, max, std for each of four frozen token columns
trace.lumina: mean, max, std for each of seven frozen token columns, including diagnostic probability columns as raw candidate inputs
trace.geometry: raw BPE count and midpoint divided by max(answer_BPE_count-1,1)

model.fusion: GELU view projections -> concat64 -> Linear64x32 -> GELU -> Linear32x16 -> GELU
model.pairs: One deterministic opposite-label mate per training claim where possible; same answer first, then same source-connected group; deduplicate; never cross groups.

crossfit.standardization: Per view, outer-training-fold median and IQR; zero IQR becomes 1; transformed values clipped to [-12,12].
crossfit.nll_threshold: Recomputed from only the outer training claims for each fold; full-fit value used only for a gated calibration pass.
crossfit.weights: Equal group mass -> answer mass -> microclaim mass -> binary-class balance -> equal group loss mass.
crossfit.thresholds: Window and answer thresholds chosen once from fit OOF separately for K=4 and K=1.

stage_gate.relation_control: Best evidence__ candidate's fit-OOF window and answer F1 from the frozen upstream summary; calibration fields are never used by the gate.
stage_gate.rule: Open calibration only if K=4 fit-OOF window F1 and answer F1 are each strictly greater than both K=1 and the relation-only control.
stage_gate.failure: Save fit-OOF artifacts and a gate-failed report; do not access calibration labels or score calibration.

projection: A lexical BPE inherits all overlapping microclaim risks; every four-BPE window and whole answer take the maximum overlapping risk.
GPU: Forbidden; every entry asserts CUDA was not initialized.
